description.en: Eiffelia globosa. Soft volume, wall thickness, color, pore spacing and the exact contact region are interpretive. Class-level placement is not asserted as settled. Species identity rests on the form obligations below, not the museum reconstruction’s color or mesh.
description.zh: Eiffelia globosa 的活体海绵复原。软组织体积、壁厚、颜色、孔隙间距和接触区域为解释性补全，纲级分类不宣称已有定论。

acceptance_obligations: Review form-1 through form-5 against the named photos and source sections. If full-volume, basal completion or spicule interpretation requires unsupported new anatomy, HOLD and name that gap rather than inventing it.

Inspect all four canonical exact-GLB directions for continuous structure, a genuinely open cavity, wall-following spicules and a completed non-pedestal base. Add one close view only if an identified criterion remains unresolved.
Record exact meter-scale body diameter and exported bounds. Confirm that scene/preview ground, lights and cameras are absent from the asset export.
Technical tests and making completion are not independent approval. Keep independent review, browser/GPU, populated world, user and deployment status separate and UNKNOWN until established.

art_direction.construction: Broad controlled planes for the primary mass; intentional connected relief for the secondary lattice; the aperture is the main negative space. No random face color, faceting noise or equal-sized repeated ornaments.
art_direction.detail_policy: Do not turn the fossil’s flattened spicule mesh into an empty wire basket. Use modest original muted materials; fossil minerals and museum render colors do not establish living colors. No copied pixels, textures or third-party mesh.
art_direction.shape_hierarchy: Quiet body envelope first, osculum second, sparse large/medium spicule structure third. Show enough secondary relief in neutral gray to distinguish a sponge from a simple pot.

frozen_scientific_scope.geometry_budget_rationale: Retain inherited ceilings only as maxima, not density goals. Spend geometry on the open rim, continuous animal volume and selected hierarchy of connected spicule detail. Avoid dense invisible microstructure.

morphology.location: ROM Description; complete ROM 53567; BOTTING2005 Description.
morphology.obligation: One globose thin-walled sac, not a flat fossil network or disconnected cage. Preserve a continuous outer body envelope and a readable open upper cavity.
One prominent upper osculum with geometric depth and a connected rim. Do not confuse the specimen crack with anatomy or replace the opening with a painted dark disc.

morphology.location: ROM 57023 and USNM 66523 photos; BOTTING2005 Description and Fig. 1 discussion.
morphology.obligation: A size hierarchy of predominantly six-rayed larger stars and smaller four-rayed spicules along the wall, with shared central junctions and tapered rays. No uniform decorative star stamps or long radial weapon-like spikes.

morphology.location: ROM 57023 description; distinction between hexaradiate and hexactine spicules.
morphology.obligation: Spicule layout remains wall-following and lattice-like, not a sea-urchin radial spray. Four surface rays must not be misreported as proof that a spicule lacked perpendicular rays.

morphology.location: Morphology and Ecological Interpretations; lectotype basal break is not living anatomy.
morphology.obligation: Retain a finished basal body surface and plausible contact, without claiming an unpreserved attachment apparatus. Sparse small ostia may be simplified, but neither their count nor distribution is species-fixed.

pose.description: Upright, quietly asymmetric sac with osculum on the upper surface. Lower body meets an invisible local contact plane. Do not include substrate, a display base, a free-standing stalk or invented roots.
pose.scene_prerequisite: A compatible seabed contact surface must be supplied by the world scene. Orientation and exact adhesion are interpretations, not preserved life-position claims.

runtime_profile.portability: No external texture or buffer dependencies. Maker records observed Blender, exporter and consuming Three.js versions.

scale.basis: ROM 53567 caption: complete specimen, 31 mm diameter. This sets nominal animal size, not a recovered uncompressed 3D measurement.
scale.measurement_rule: Measure maximum transverse body diameter without projecting spicule tips; record final full XYZ bounds separately. Never enlarge the exported source to make it visible at a distant world camera.

scientific_limits.en: Soft volume, wall thickness, color, pore spacing and the exact contact region are interpretive. Class-level placement is not asserted as settled. Species identity rests on the form obligations below, not the museum reconstruction’s color or mesh.

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original static whole-animal candidate for a locality-matched Cambrian seafloor in the user’s prehistoric 3D world. Evidence-informed stylization, not a fossil slab, geological display, specimen facsimile or complete ecological scene. Preparation only; no geometry exists here.

surface_profile.materials: Original muted natural palette; color is artistic. No fossil-mineral staining, institutional pixels or copied reconstruction palette.
surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.normal_style: Intentional broad body planes with restrained continuous detail; no uniform noise.

taxon.age_context: Selected Walcott Quarry, Burgess Shale, Middle Cambrian context. ROM gives approximately 505 Ma; that historical approximate date is not a precise calibrated scene timestamp.
anatomical_anchors: ROM 53567 for complete outline and scale; USNM 66522 for osculum; ROM 57023 and USNM 66523 for spicule form. See references.json.
taxon.classification_scope: Porifera; heteractinid with mixed calcarean/hexactinellid characters. Retain historical and phylogenetic uncertainty (BOTTING2005).
taxon.geographic_context: Walcott Quarry, Fossil Ridge, British Columbia, Canada.

view_plan.extra_views: None by default; add a local view only for a specific unresolved issue.
view_plan.final_source: Clean import of exact delivered GLB. Perspective and preview may reuse identical bytes.
view_plan.greybox_note: Inspect inexpensive clay views for sac volume, aperture, spicule relief and basal completion before final exact-GLB four views.
view_plan.website_reuse: Website renderer/camera configuration has not been verified during prep. Keep canonical QA directions, do not claim website compatibility, and do not produce 768x432 derivatives here.

world_use.integration_boundary: Static standalone animal only. Substrate, placement system, rigging, animation, collision, LOD, GPU performance, populated-world review and deployment remain unverified.
world_use.placement: Centimeter-scale seafloor fauna; use camera proximity rather than baked scale inflation. Match period, locality and habitat before combining with other animals. Shared Cambrian tags alone do not establish coexistence.
world_use.role: Small sessile benthic suspension-feeding animal, not decorative geology.
